name: Practice Plan — Thursday AM, three lanes
description: Squad practice for twelve swimmers in three lane groups (1 sprint, 2 middle distance, 3 distance) with one coach on deck, one set of starting blocks and three lanes, inside 150 minutes of pool time. Everything except the sprint set runs in all three lanes at once; the sprint set is one lane group at a time off the single set of blocks, and both the block queue and the cooldown wait on the last lane in. At the planned defaults: brief 0-5, warm-up 5-25, whiteboard 25-30, kick 30-50, main sets 50-90/95/100, block queue 100-130, cooldown 130-140, debrief 140-150 minutes.

metadata.poolTime: 150 minutes (9000 seconds) of pool time; at the planned defaults the coach track ends at 9000s, so all tracks finish together on the ceiling
metadata.scalingNote: The sprint set is one step with replicates count 3, serial, so the single set of starting blocks serialises the three lane groups without copied steps. No maxInFlight: with no instances "each" chain downstream of the replicate, an in-flight cap would hold nothing back. Lane 3's "extra rest" is inherent in being third in a serial queue behind a 50-minute main set.
metadata.joins: Two joins, both from the source note: the block queue and the stopwatch start on a compound "all" over the three main-set ends (the last lane in), and the cooldown starts on a compound "all" over the stopwatch ending and the block queue's three-turn barrier.
metadata.bindingConstraint: The single set of starting blocks plus lane 3's 50-minute main set jointly set the makespan; lanes 1 and 2 stand down 10 and 5 minutes and the coach is idle 69 minutes, which is the only slack in the morning.
